aboutGame.title: What Is DreadmoorWiki?
paragraphs: Dreadmoor is a dark fantasy survival adventure on Steam. You sail a fog-bound world, fish its waters, scavenge ruins, craft tools, and upgrade your boat so every expedition reaches farther before the dark closes in.

DreadmoorWiki gathers that knowledge in one place: beginner routing, fishing mechanics, crafting discipline, boat upgrades, creature behavior, release tracking, and platform details, so new survivors can plan a run instead of losing one.

explore.title: Explore DreadmoorWiki
explore.description: Master Dreadmoor with beginner routing, fishing and crafting databases, creature behavior, boat upgrade paths, release tracking, and platform details.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: DreadmoorWiki's beginner guide covers the core gameplay loop, first expeditions, survival preparation, crafting priorities, and the early progression choices that keep a new run alive.

highlights.detail: Establish a safe anchor point you can retreat to within your first ten minutes.
Secure a reliable light source before you read terrain, threats, or exits.
Learn your own noise profile to control how far attention travels.
Scout one route out and back instead of wandering into unknown ground.
Bank a small supply reserve before your first long trip away from shelter.
Skip every fight you cannot profit from and keep your progress intact.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki Fishing Guide
modules.description: The DreadmoorWiki fishing guide explains fishing mechanics, bait usage, catching strategies, valuable species, and how catches feed cooking, crafting, and trade.

highlights.label: Spots
highlights.detail: Fish structure, drop-offs, and wrecks instead of casting into empty flats.

highlights.label: Bait
highlights.detail: Match basic, mid-tier, or premium bait to the water you are actually fishing.

highlights.label: Reel
highlights.detail: Release pressure at tension peaks so a high-value catch does not snap your line.

highlights.label: Night
highlights.detail: Night pools hold rarer species, so carry light and set an exit condition first.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki Crafting Guide
modules.description: The DreadmoorWiki crafting guide covers materials, recipes, survival tools, equipment improvements, and how scavenged resources turn into stronger gear.

highlights.label: Tools
highlights.detail: Craft survival tools the moment you need them, not the moment you can.

highlights.label: Repairs
highlights.detail: Keep repair materials for gear you can replace after a costly loss.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Drop hoarded materials and carry only what your next upgrade needs.

highlights.label: Upgrades
highlights.detail: Never spend your last critical material on an optional upgrade.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki Boat Upgrades
modules.description: DreadmoorWiki boat upgrades focus on trawler improvements, ship equipment, exploration range, and the upgrade order that protects a long expedition.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Fuel capacity comes first, because range gates every distant objective.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Hull plating next, so collisions and hostile zones do not end the run.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Engine upgrades reward pilots who already handle throttle and momentum.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Storage and lighting come later, once range and survival are covered.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki Creatures Guide
modules.description: The DreadmoorWiki creatures guide covers dangerous monsters, aquatic threats, detection behavior, and the survival tactics that get you home.

highlights.label: Patrol
highlights.detail: Learn patrol routes and move quietly while a creature is still idle.

highlights.label: Suspicion
highlights.detail: Freeze or break line of sight the moment awareness starts to fill.

highlights.label: Search
highlights.detail: Leave the area while a creature hunts your last known position.

highlights.label: Escape
highlights.detail: Commit to a planned escape route instead of fighting every threat.

modules.name: DreadmoorWiki System Requirements
modules.description: DreadmoorWiki system requirements list the hardware, memory, graphics, and storage details you should check before you buy.

highlights.label: Windows
highlights.detail: Confirm your exact operating system build is supported before buying.

highlights.label: 8 GB RAM
highlights.detail: Check total memory, not available memory, against the listed requirement.

highlights.label: GPU Tier
highlights.detail: Match the listed graphics tier instead of comparing number series.

highlights.label: SSD
highlights.detail: Note both the required space and the drive type before you install.

highlights.label: Deck
highlights.detail: Check the Steam Deck compatibility badge alongside community reports.

faq.description: Quick answers about DreadmoorWiki and the Dreadmoor survival loop.

items.question: What is DreadmoorWiki?
items.answer: DreadmoorWiki is a player-built guide hub for Dreadmoor, covering beginner routing, fishing, crafting, boat upgrades, creatures, release tracking, and platform details.

items.question: How does DreadmoorWiki help new players?
items.answer: DreadmoorWiki starts with a step-by-step beginner guide, then connects fishing, crafting, and survival topics so your first hours build a safe anchor and a reliable resource reserve.

items.question: Which DreadmoorWiki guides should I read first?
items.answer: Read the DreadmoorWiki beginner guide first, then the fishing and crafting sections, and check the release page for platform and demo details.

items.question: Does DreadmoorWiki cover boat upgrades?
items.answer: Yes. The DreadmoorWiki boat module ranks fuel capacity and hull plating above raw speed, because range and survival carry every long expedition.

items.question: Where does DreadmoorWiki track codes and updates?
items.answer: The DreadmoorWiki codes and release modules follow official Steam and community channels for redeem codes, giveaways, and patch news.
